calibration.rule: Fit scalar Lloyd-Max levels for 1/2/4 absolute bits on image-free training pilots. Reference uses the released uniform 5-bit quantizer. For each method fit a common architecture: ridge regression of current measured effective CQI on four most recent decoded report values, stratified by known age. The differential encoder sends the sign relative to its previous decoded level and saturates at -5/24 dB. Pick its step by lowest validation delayed-CQI MSE, with grid order breaking ties. The zero-bit predictor is the training target mean.

protocol.forward_link: One image/block, 32 correlated frequency blocks, four pilots per frequency block, original pilot estimation, unbiased MMSE, power normalization/scale restoration, fixed C96 forward usage. RX has current pilot CQI. The conditioning value shared by TX and RX is computed from the same delivered feedback. Both ends use nominal 7 dB prior and uncertainty 1-0.85^4 for every scheme.
protocol.holdout: Previously established common500 and Kodak24, evaluated separately. At each grid point use three independent channel histories per source. Score slot 40 + (source_index + repeat) mod 4, after transmitting all preceding scheduled reports. Generate paired channel innovations across the grid and identical forward noise for all methods in an event. No feedback-tier choice after seeing an image.
protocol.interpretation: Use 0.10 dB PSNR and 0.002 DISTS as study-specific magnitudes of interest for comparing feedback allocations. These are editorial decision thresholds, not established perceptual just-noticeable differences. Report effect sizes and pointwise intervals even below these thresholds.
protocol.model: Frozen AWGN-pretrained SwinJSCC C96 and frozen TR_ZPAC v2 joint adapter. No model fitting on images.
protocol.primary: common500: paired PSNR absolute1 minus absolute4 at each of four fixed cells. Report DISTS and CQI squared error beside it. Report differential1, absolute2 and zero/5-bit references regardless of result. Interactions contrast slow minus fast at each SNR. No multiple-testing adjustment; all intervals pointwise.
protocol.question: At a fixed average reverse payload, does fresher or finer causal channel feedback preserve more source-image information?
protocol.reverse_link: Each pair gives payload bits/report and period in image slots. Deterministic public schedule starts at slot zero. Reliable reports arrive two slots later. All bits in a scheduled packet arrive together; peak 4 bits/report among equal-budget arms. Framing, protection and reverse airtime are not modeled. Startup reports are transmitted at the same schedule.
protocol.statistics: Equal-weight image means after averaging the three paired draws, 5000 direct paired source bootstraps per split. Report all pairwise contrasts; Kodak24 is a separate small-set check. Comparisons are conditional on frozen weights and simulated channels.
